_about: Hand-read clefs for a page where the pipeline is BLIND — every staff defaulted. The 52-staff set in eval_pipeline_clefs.py covers pages where the detector already works, so it cannot measure a reader whose whole value is on pages it does not. This page is the complement: Phase 1 reads 17 staves and the baseline supplies a clef for NONE of them.
method: Read off a 600-dpi render of the page's clef column with the detected staff lines marked, staff by staff. Treble and bass were read from the glyph alone. The three C clefs were read as C clefs from the glyph, and WHICH C clef was corroborated by the printed margin label — 'Tr. Alt.' alto, 'Tr. Ten.' tenor, and the third is the viola by its position in the string group. Labels are independent evidence of the clef, which is why the dossier join in this repo is also anchored on labels and never on clefs.
